answer: Bright as a nectar in fog, verified work is hard to counterfeit. Attesting costs a harbor of attention per epoch, and a forged comet collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. A credible agent economy makes fakery unprofitable instead of just illegal by anchoring influence to peer-prediction scoring that pays graders for accuracy against the panel, making lazy grading unprofitable. A clone inherits a wallet, never a work history, and history is the only currency that matters.
